mintAuthority.summary: sUSD1+ is a Lorenzo strategy-vault receipt whose base USD1 authority is inherited from the reviewed parent — confirmed on-chain by underlying() resolving to BSC USD1 — while the local BSC UUPS upgrade authority narrows to two AccessControl registries whose role holders cannot be enumerated from keyless public reads.

controls.label: sUSD1+ wrapper token
controls.capDescription: Wrapper/share accounting over Lorenzo USD1+ strategy exposure; does not mint base USD1.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 111074113, the proxy's EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xaafe784a51f119d38e57717fd8a00f844bd86f13 while the standard admin and beacon slots were zero. UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION() returned 5.0.0, but asset(), owner(), getOwner(), and admin() did not identify a local controller. Extending the probe set on 2026-07-20 by enumerating the implementation's dispatch selectors and calling each no-argument getter through the proxy: underlying() (0x6f307dc3) returns 0x8d0d000ee44948fc98c9b98a4fa4921476f08b0d, the BSC USD1 token, giving the first on-chain confirmation of the inherited-parent relation that had been asserted only from local metadata; decimals() is 18 and totalSupply() is 143,617,058.81 shares read at chain head block 111123412. authority(), pendingOwner(), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE(), getRoleAdmin(), and isTrustedForwarder() also revert, so the wrapper carries neither Ownable, AccessControl, nor AccessManaged.

controls.label: sUSD1+ unresolved UUPS upgrade authority
controls.capDescription: A UUPS implementation replacement may change local share-mint logic, but public reads do not identify the account or contract authorized by _authorizeUpgrade.
controls.evidence: The proxy reports UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0 and resolves to implementation 0xaafe784a51f119d38e57717fd8a00f844bd86f13, but all tested owner/admin getters revert. Selector enumeration of that implementation on 2026-07-20 shows it exposes mint(address,uint256), pause(), unpause(), upgradeToAndCall and proxiableUUID, but no Ownable, AccessControl, or AccessManaged entry point, so _authorizeUpgrade must consult an external registry. Two such registries are reachable from the proxy: getter 0x99b2d1d4 returns 0xaefc9cece593b28faead5c096856d68082254867 and getter 0xe9c7970a returns 0x507ec48ef26919a205a9f3b8aaf69532e20c0987. Both are 342-byte ERC-1967 proxies reporting UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION 5.0.0; their implementations 0xc536323e3a4d543cecece0aedd973e0e0ea25c47 and 0x6e0f4dc0d748e4917b418357d989b2023b8b7a20 both expose the full OpenZeppelin AccessControl set (hasRole, grantRole, revokeRole, getRoleAdmin, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) plus upgradeToAndCall, and 0xaefc9cec additionally exposes mint. The role holders cannot be enumerated because AccessControl publishes membership only through RoleGranted logs and every keyless BSC endpoint reachable here caps eth_getLogs at a 50,000-block range with no archive access, so no signer, threshold, or admin account is attributed. This narrows the upgrade surface to two named AccessControl registries but still confirms an unresolved controller identity.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-20. Local metadata establishes sUSD1+ as a USD1 strategy-vault variant, so base USD1 supply authority remains inherited rather than copied into the child controls. At BSC block 111074113, the local proxy is an OZ 5 UUPS surface with implementation 0xaafe784a51f119d38e57717fd8a00f844bd86f13 and zero standard EIP-1967 admin/beacon slots. owner(), getOwner(), admin(), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE(), and asset() did not identify a controller; slot 0's nested UUPS proxy also has no readable owner. A second pass the same day enumerated the implementation's dispatch selectors and called every no-argument getter through the proxy: underlying() returns BSC USD1 0x8d0d000ee44948fc98c9b98a4fa4921476f08b0d, confirming the inherited-parent relation on-chain, and two AccessControl+UUPS registries (0xaefc9cece593b28faead5c096856d68082254867 and 0x507ec48ef26919a205a9f3b8aaf69532e20c0987) are reachable from the wrapper. Their role holders remain unenumerable without archive log access, so the controller identity is narrowed but not resolved. No independent reconciliation or named prudential supervisor is established for this local strategy wrapper.
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and any upgrade role on AccessControl registries 0xaefc9cece593b28faead5c096856d68082254867 and 0x507ec48ef26919a205a9f3b8aaf69532e20c0987, which the sUSD1+ proxy exposes through getters 0x99b2d1d4 and 0xe9c7970a. Both implement the full OpenZeppelin AccessControl set, so membership is recoverable from RoleGranted logs, but that needs an archive-capable BSC endpoint or a BscScan API key; every keyless endpoint reachable here caps eth_getLogs at 50,000 blocks. This is now the shortest path to a controller identity for this asset.

Determine whether 0xaefc9cec…4867 is the vault/minter for sUSD1+ shares: its implementation 0xc536323e3a4d543cecece0aedd973e0e0ea25c47 exposes mint alongside AccessControl, while 0x507ec48e…0987's implementation 0x6e0f4dc0d748e4917b418357d989b2023b8b7a20 does not.

Obtain verified source for implementation 0xaafe784a51f119d38e57717fd8a00f844bd86f13 (or Lorenzo disclosure) to confirm which registry _authorizeUpgrade consults and whether any timelock or threshold applies before attributing a controller.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified 2026-07-20 via Lorenzo's own USD1+ OTF guide: USD1+ is the first On-chain Traded Fund on Lorenzo's Financial Abstraction Layer on BNB Chain, aggregating RWA, CeFi quant-trading, and DeFi returns with all yield settled in USD1; sUSD1+ is the staked receipt minted against USD1 deposits at unit NAV, subject to a 7-day minimum hold and a biweekly withdrawal-settlement cycle back into USD1. The wrapper dependency on tracked USD1 (usd1-world-liberty-financial, depType wrapper) is therefore confirmed, but Lorenzo publishes no strategy-level weights or portfolio breakdown, so scope stays dependency-relationships rather than full-composition. Risk stays high: a delta-neutral sleeve alone would tier medium, but the managed strategy runs through undisclosed off-chain CeFi execution with unverified wrapper upgrade authority, so the riskier tier is kept.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-3 (lead usdd-tron-dao-reserve)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The OTF model is on-chain fundraising, off-chain execution, on-chain settlement: deposited funds leave the BNB Chain vault into strategy execution, and Lorenzo's own disclaimer states it 'does not manage user funds and is not responsible for the performance of any underlying strategy'. Who holds strategy assets off-chain (custodians, prime brokers, exchanges), whether accounts are segregated, and what insolvency treatment applies are all undisclosed, so segregation is unknown and no bankruptcy-remoteness structure is documented (recorded as none). Active deployment of vault assets into off-chain strategies is the disclosed design, recorded as permitted rehypothecation of the reserve. Separately, the sUSD1+ BSC proxy implementation is unverified and its upgrade authority unresolved (mintAuthority review, 2026-06-11). Withdrawals follow a 7-day minimum hold plus a biweekly settlement cycle, so exit liquidity depends on strategy settlement rather than instant on-chain redemption.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: sUSD1+ is the strategy-bearing staked layer and intentionally departs from the USD1 fiat-reserve parent mechanism.
